title: Looking Back at GTA 5's Ultimate Silicon Valley Satire Ahead of GTA 6
description: Ahead of GTA 6, IGN looks back at how GTA 5 took on Silicon Valley, bad fashion, exploding phones, and a fake Zuckerberg in a memorable satirical takedown.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Legacy of GTA 5's Silicon Valley Satire Ahead of GTA 6

As anticipation continues to build for the eventual release of *GTA 6*, looking back at how Rockstar Games has historically tackled real-world absurdities offers a great reminder of the series' unique charm. According to a retrospective by IGN Games, *GTA 5* delivered one of the most memorable and biting takedowns of Silicon Valley, modern tech culture, and tech moguls in gaming history.

### A Masterclass in Modern Satire

Rockstar has always excelled at holding up a mirror to society's most ridiculous trends. In *GTA 5*, the studio brilliantly brought together terrible fashion choices, a miserable gangster, a notoriously exploding phone, and a fake, Zuckerberg-esque tech CEO receiving his just deserts. This concoction created an unforgettable satirical experience that resonated deeply with players, combining chaotic gameplay with sharp social commentary.

### What This Means for GTA 6

While we await official details from Rockstar regarding *GTA 6*, industry analysis suggests that the developer's trademark satirical edge will only sharpen in the upcoming title. Given how much digital culture, social media obsession, and influencer-driven phenomena have evolved since *GTA 5* launched, *GTA 6* is primed to target modern tech giants and internet culture with the same fearless comedic approach.

### Editor's Take

*GTA 5*'s ability to skewer the tech elite remains a high-water mark for open-world storytelling. As we look forward to *GTA 6*, it's clear that Rockstar's commitment to biting social satire is essential to what makes the franchise truly legendary.
